title: Thirty-seven-thousand-source evidence firewall: 27-mode finite-clock photonic benchmark

null27_quantum_walk.structural_input: 27 vertices indexed by Sym_2(F3); edge iff det(S_i-S_j)=0 and i != j
null27_quantum_walk.time: t_star=2*pi/9 for L=8*I-A, with absolute generator calibration fixed separately

data_freeze: First laboratory detector-click/count and interferometric-phase data recorded after this file has been committed and hardware calibration has been independently locked.
measurement_protocol: 27 prepared basis inputs, at least 5000 independently heralded accepted detections per input, all 27 output ports read; three preselected 2-input/2-output plaquette phases measured with separate phase-reference calibration.
decision_rule: For each of 27 inputs, evaluate a fixed 26-degree-of-freedom multinomial Pearson goodness-of-fit statistic for the vector P=1/27; reject globally if any corrected Holm familywise p-value <0.05. Separately compare each plaquette phase with its exact cyclotomic target under a phase-noise standard deviation determined exclusively by independent calibration; Holm-correct the three phase residual tests at familywise 0.05. Report all failed and passed cells, no post-hoc selection.
noise_model: Detector-loss efficiencies and cross-talk matrices estimated on separate control data with blind analysis; propagate uncertainties by a frozen bootstrap with fixed seed 20261108 and a pre-published uncertainty budget. Conditioned-count selection must be frozen before data are viewed.
comparator_family: ordinary quantum mechanics for exactly the same calibrated Laplacian (identical prediction, so no TOE discrimination)
degree-preserving graph rewiring chosen without looking at observed counts
time calibration t=t_star+delta with delta drawn from independent reference uncertainty
measured phase-loss/crosstalk nuisance model, fixed before the holdout
multiplicity: The full 27x27 probability table and three plaquette phases count as one joint vector. No dropping difficult outputs, changing graph labeling, shifting t, or replacing formulas after observation.
physical_scope: Tests the ability to implement the selected W33 finite-clock quantum walk as ordinary quantum mechanics. Not a new physical law; neither a dimensionful universal constant nor E6 vacuum nor Lorentzian gravity is being predicted.
